content:
Amazon is having a big ol' Pokémon TCG restock this week in the run-up to its Black Friday sale (Nov. 19), and so far, some of the deals have been absolutely out of this world.

Right now, Pokémon TCG's latest expansion, Delta Reign, is in stock at Amazon. Booster Bundles are checking out for just $31.99, which can only be considered one of the best non-MSRP deals I've seen at the major retailer this year.

This is much lower than the current market price at TCGplayer right now as well, which sits at $43.61 at the time of publication.

I'm typing this quite frantically because I'm terribly worried this wonderful offer is going to sell out before I can click publish. If they are still in stock when you are reading this, I highly encourage you to check out ASAP to avoid disappointment, as this is a Black Friday-quality deal in my opinion.

Yes, while it's still above MSRP, even being below market rate is a deal at this point with Pokémon TCG. Take it or leave it, is my best advice. If you want to spend this kind of money on boosters, you go right ahead, I won't judge.

It's a much better deal compared to most other booster bundles from the TCG this year as well, which average out at $50-$100 market rate almost every time.

No matter where you buy from, though, your Delta Reign Booster Bundle will have the exact same contents: six Pokémon TCG booster packs from the titular expansion.

That means six chances to pull the 135+ card collection’s most valuable chase cards (which are also available to buy individually on TCGplayer ) — including the $250+ MHR Mega Rayquaza ex, the $95+ SIR version of Mega Rayquaza ex, and the $90+ SIR Raikou ex.

So what other deals/ Pokémon TCG restocks has Amazon got right now?

For starters, Pokémon TCG's 30th Celebration Ultra-Premium Collection is officially back in stock at Amazon ahead of the retailer's massive Black Friday sale, which kicks off on November 19.

We've seen fleeting appearances of this elusive UPC at other retailers recently, but this is the first time we've spotted anything resembling consistent availability at a major retailer.

The catch? It's $399.99. Yeah, that's pricey. Unfortunately, it's also not too far removed from the going rate for the Night variant on the secondary market. TCGplayer currently lists it at a median price of around $399.99, although its market price is closer to $372.64, with the most recent sale coming in at $371.87.

Otherwise, there's also more 30th anniversary goods up at Amazon right now. The 30th Celebration Ditto Premium Collection is also now available for $39.99, while the 30th Celebration Knockback Deck is also available, this time for $31.84.
